evals.name: protect-negative-read
evals.prompt: A reservation checks an absent allocation, then a concurrent allocation appears. Preserve the decision boundary.
assertions: Acquires the absence under the same guarded unit of work as the staged result.
Inserts the conflicting write after acquisition and before commit.
Verifies no contradictory event and a changed decision on a fresh read.

evals.name: determine-effective-mode
evals.prompt: Does Measure mode on an ordinary Arc Handle model argument prevent a stale append?
assertions: Identifies On as the enforcing mode.
Checks the effective mode including configured maximum.
Does not claim ordinary measured reads are enforced.

evals.name: refuse-unguarded-fallback
evals.prompt: Guard admission failed. Should the command catch the error and immediately append?
evals.expected_output: Fail closed and classify the refusal.
assertions: Distinguishes inability to enforce from a relevant dependency change.
Re-evaluates the full decision rather than blindly replaying a stale write.
